entities.name: Carolina Ödman-Govender
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carolina Ödman-Govender was a Swiss physicist and academic who was professor of astrophysics at South Africa's University of the Western Cape. She was awarded the 2018 International Astronomical Union Special Executive Committee Award for Astronomy Outreach, Development and Education.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carolina Ödman-Govender was a Swiss physicist and academic who was professor of astrophysics at South Africa's University of the Western Cape. She was awarded the 2018 International Astronomical Union Special Executive Committee Award for Astronomy Outreach, Development and Education.
